referenceSources.title: Maximum Attack — Ecurie
referenceSources.description:
A striking white and yellow Renault 5 Maxi Turbo blasts through a nighttime rally stage, its four powerful spotlights cutting through the darkness. The compact hatchback’s widened arches, rear wing, and sponsor logos—Michelin, Jaeger, Valeo—underscore its Group B rally heritage. Inside, driver and co-driver wear full helmets as they tackle a winding tarmac road bordered by rocky terrain.

Part of Ecurie’s “Maximum Attack” collection, this 1985 example was campaigned by double World Rally Champion Carlos Sainz in the Spanish Rally Championship. The R5 Maxi Turbo represents the final evolution of Renault’s mid-engined, turbocharged rally car, boasting 345 hp. It joins six other legendary Group B machines—Audi Sport Quattro S1, Peugeot 205 T16 Evo 2, Lancia 037 and S4, Ford RS200, MG Metro 6R4—set for auction by Artcurial Motorcars on 5 February 2021.
